verdict.rationale: The evidence shows monday.com as a general board and item tracker. It can link GitHub/GitLab pull requests to items, automate status reports and flag progress gaps, and community users describe running software project tickets on it, though they report weak ticket linking and lost data. Nothing in the pack documents sprint-specific capability. Missing for 10: documented sprint creation and planning, backlog and sprint scoping, velocity or burndown tracking, sprint retrospectives or rollover, and independent corroboration that agile sprint workflows work well.
